description: Launch a new index fund: the wallet seeds it with the exact amount of each basket token (it must hold them) and receives `initialShares` shares. The seed amounts set the weights. Returns the approvals and the factory deployment call, plus the new index's predicted address.

amount.description: amount of the token to seed, in whole tokens, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "0.5"

initialShares.description: shares minted for the seed, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "0.5"

mandate.description: the index's investment mandate, shown to buyers

wallet.description: the agent's wallet address — the one that will sign and send the calls

name: build_create_index
title: Build: create an index
